source.title: Staged cranial resection of a left parietal high-grade glioma following intraoperative hemodynamic instability: a case report

presentation: A 54-year-old man with no relevant medical history presented in October 2023 with a two-month history of episodic vertigo and progressive retrograde amnesia. Neurological examination showed bradypsychia, acalculia, and agraphia consistent with an incomplete Gerstmann syndrome. Motor strength was 5/5 throughout (MRC scale) with no cranial nerve deficits or pyramidal signs

events.detail: Gadolinium-enhanced magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) of the brain.
events.source_span: Gadolinium-enhanced magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) on 27 December 2023, revealed a heterogeneous left parietal intra-axial lesion

events.detail: Heterogeneous left parietal intra-axial lesion isointense on T1, with hypointense areas consistent with necrosis and cystic degeneration, poorly defined borders, extensive perilesional vasogenic edema, and a midline shift of 7.32 mm.
events.source_span: revealed a heterogeneous left parietal intra-axial lesion isointense on T1, with hypointense areas consistent with necrosis and cystic degeneration, poorly defined borders, extensive perilesional vasogenic edema, and a midline shift of 7.32 mm

events.detail: Proton MR spectroscopy analysis of the left parietal lesion.
events.source_span: Proton MR spectroscopy analysis of the left parietal lesion showing significant peaks of N-acetylaspartate and choline, compatible with a high-grade tumor lesion.

events.detail: Significant peaks of N-acetylaspartate and choline, compatible with a high-grade tumor lesion.
events.source_span: showing significant peaks of N-acetylaspartate and choline, compatible with a high-grade tumor lesion.

events.summary: left frontoparietal decompressive craniectomy and cytoreduction
events.detail: Left frontoparietal decompressive craniectomy with intended cytoreduction.
events.source_span: The patient underwent a left frontoparietal decompressive craniectomy with intended cytoreduction on 30 December 2023.

events.summary: intraoperative hypertensive crisis and venous hemorrhage
events.detail: An acute hypertensive crisis during resection produced spontaneous venous hemorrhage unresponsive to bipolar cauterization and hemostatic packing, with progressive cerebral edema.
events.source_span: An acute hypertensive crisis during resection produced spontaneous venous hemorrhage unresponsive to bipolar cauterization and hemostatic packing. Progressive cerebral edema persisted despite partial cytoreduction and fluid optimization.

events.detail: Resection was aborted with residual tumor left in situ due to sustained hemodynamic compromise and risk of neurovascular injury.
events.source_span: Given the sustained hemodynamic compromise and the risk of further neurovascular injury, the resection was aborted with residual tumor left in situ.

events.detail: Postoperative computed tomography to assess for complications.
events.source_span: Postoperative computed tomography showed no infarction, postsurgical hematoma, or herniation

events.detail: No infarction, postsurgical hematoma, or herniation.
events.source_span: showed no infarction, postsurgical hematoma, or herniation

events.detail: Histopathological analysis of the resected tumor tissue.
Intravascular endothelial hyperplasia compatible with diffuse glioma of adult type, histologically grade 4.
events.source_span: intravascular endothelial hyperplasia compatible with diffuse glioma of adult type, histologically grade 4.

events.detail: High-grade glioma (diffuse glioma of adult type, histologically grade 4).
Brief mechanical ventilation, extubated without incident, and discharged with GCS 15. Bradypsychia improved, but acalculia and agraphia persisted.
events.source_span: The patient required brief mechanical ventilation, was extubated without incident, and was discharged with GCS 15. Bradypsychia had improved. Acalculia and agraphia persisted.

events.detail: Readmitted approximately 85 days later with progressive increased volume at the craniectomy site and nausea.
events.source_span: Approximately 85 days later, the patient was readmitted with progressive increased volume at the craniectomy site and nausea.

events.detail: Repeat neuroimaging to evaluate the residual tumor and craniectomy site.
events.source_span: Repeat neuroimaging showed residual tumor without interval growth, ischemia, or new hemorrhage.

events.detail: Residual tumor without interval growth, ischemia, or new hemorrhage.
events.source_span: showed residual tumor without interval growth, ischemia, or new hemorrhage.

events.detail: Left parietal lobectomy performed through the prior craniectomy using neuronavigation and sodium fluorescein-enhanced visualization.
events.source_span: On 25 March 2024, a left parietal lobectomy was performed through the prior craniectomy. Neuronavigation and sodium fluorescein-enhanced visualization were used to delineate tumor margins within the altered operative field.

events.detail: Gross total resection was achieved without intraoperative incidents.
events.source_span: Gross total resection was achieved without intraoperative incidents.

events.detail: Discharged on postoperative Day 2 at GCS 15. Agraphia improved, mild acalculia remained, with no surgical, infectious, or thromboembolic complications.
events.source_span: The patient was discharged on postoperative Day 2 at GCS 15. Agraphia had improved and mild acalculia remained. No surgical, infectious, or thromboembolic complications occurred.
